title: Hemoglobin–RDW interactions yield an uncertain, tail-sensitive cross-cycle auditory-threshold prediction gain
abstract: In exploratory NHANES2011–2012 to2015–2016 transfer, six hemoglobin–RDW interaction terms reduced high-frequency auditory-threshold MSE from162.543 to161.414 dB², but joint PSU-bootstrap95% interval for the change was[−12.819,22.373] dB². Benefit was not established and disappeared under ordinary-blood-index and common-support restrictions.
